name: HUD DRGR financial records
provider: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
unit: Original award × project × activity × reporting quarter
vintage: Observed reporting quarters; national filename date is not treated as a verified extraction date.
availability: 128,382 national F31 financial rows across 206 awards, 2002Q2–2025Q1. Separate Texas Harvey F31 snapshot: 6,518 rows, 2018Q3–2026Q1. Search, filter and export exact signed financial measures.
definition: Five fields are signed quarterly net flows, not cumulative snapshots: obligations, expenditures, grant disbursements, program-income disbursements and receipts. Preserve zeros and negative adjustments.
missingness: Absent quarters are unknown. Allocation histories and verified initial execution dates require separate evidence.
linkage: Preserve original text identifiers and one source snapshot; never sum overlapping extracts.
rights: Public-document financial fields released under explicit project authorization. National financial chunks and dictionaries independently acquired from the public CECREH repository and reconciled. Upstream MIT license retained. No narratives, SimpleMaps coordinates or household data copied.

name: Texas GLO quarterly performance reports
provider: Texas General Land Office / HUD DRGR
unit: Report × activity × funding source; period and to-date columns
vintage: 2024Q4 report; source index includes later reports.
availability: Newly downloaded official Harvey 2024Q4 PDF: exact activity/grant/quarter location-scope links and selected period-dollar checks. Report status: Submitted—Await for Review.
definition: Documentary source for activity scope and explicitly labeled financial columns. A portfolio may combine original grants.
missingness: Blank award or obligation dates cannot supply verified initial execution dates. Report submission does not mean HUD approval.
linkage: Match original award, project, activity, funding source and reporting quarter. Do not allocate portfolio totals to cities.
rights: Public agency financial facts and non-household geographic references. PDFs and source narratives are linked rather than republished.

name: Census land-clipped cartographic boundaries
availability: 56 state/territory, 3,235 county/parish, 32,629 place and 36,360 county-subdivision reference polygons. Regional Albers projection. These are reference layers, not funded-activity polygons.
definition: Reference areas and representative points identify geography. They do not locate an activity or its beneficiaries.
missingness: Historical boundary equivalence is unverified. Some area types lack coordinates; they stay off the map.
linkage: Use documented government-to-area identity evidence. Headquarters counties and state context do not establish service areas.
rights: U.S. Census Bureau public government data; official ZIP hashes and transformation notes retained. No third-party city coordinates used.

name: ACS population & housing context
unit: Census geography × five-year estimate period; estimates and MOEs
vintage: Choose a common ACS release and compatible boundaries
availability: Source link and required schema; no ACS estimates bundled.
definition: Population, income, poverty and housing estimates describe community context; five-year estimates are not independent quarterly measurements.
missingness: No ACS estimates are included. Obtain the chosen release with its estimate universe, margins of error and missing-value codes.
linkage: Retain estimate universe, margin of error, vintage and string GEOID. Reconcile changing tract boundaries before city aggregation.
rights: Review the chosen release. No API key is embedded or requested by this dashboard.

name: Flood hazard & hydrologic context
unit: Flood-zone polygon, raster or documented exposure aggregate
vintage: Map effective date and acquisition date must be retained
availability: Source inventory only; no hazard layers bundled.
definition: Mapped flood hazard, observed flood loss and hydrologic exposure are different constructs.
missingness: No boundary-consistent city exposure is supplied here. Unmapped or unmatched areas are not zero risk.
linkage: Record CRS, coverage, map revision, spatial operation and denominator. Confirm rights before distributing derived layers.
rights: Official reference lead; layer terms and derivation rights require review.

name: Land cover & land-use evidence
unit: Raster cell or documented municipal land-area share
vintage: Select an NLCD release; legacy epochs and Annual NLCD differ
availability: Official source link; no raster or municipal shares bundled.
definition: Land cover measures observed surface classes. It is not a zoning or land-use regulation measure.
missingness: No municipal composition estimates included. Building permits do not replace land-cover shares.
linkage: Use compatible boundaries, an explicit land/water denominator, class definitions and raster vintage.
rights: Official source reference only; identify the specific release before redistribution.

name: Government identity & resources
provider: U.S. Census Bureau / BLS / local governments
unit: Government unit; fiscal year; employment period
vintage: 2022 government-unit identity reference; resource vintages vary
availability: 92,150 2022 government-inventory entries, including general-purpose governments, special districts and school systems. No fiscal/staffing measurements bundled.
definition: Government existence is separate from fiscal resources, staffing, NGO capacity and administrative performance.
missingness: Government entries can include inactive units and dependent school systems. No district service-area geometries or resource indicators supplied. Unresolved identities are not forced matches.
linkage: Separate sovereign and legal identities from statistical areas. Government headquarters do not define financial allocation boundaries.
rights: Official Census of Governments public unit-name, type, identifier and function fields. Headquarters addresses and most-served counties omitted from maps.

name: Building Permits Survey
unit: Place × calendar year; housing units and valuation
vintage: Calendar year and release-specific; verify reporting-month coverage
availability: Source reference; observed place-year coverage varies.
definition: Permitting describes housing supply activity. It is not staffing, land-use composition or recovery effectiveness.
missingness: Incomplete reporting months and unresolved source footnotes must remain visible.
linkage: Join exact place GEOID and year; never fill earlier periods with later-year context.
rights: No permit records bundled; review source definitions and release conditions.
